title: PMED forearm CHEPS 10 s hold
citation: Gouverneur et al. (2024). An Experimental and Clinical Physiological Signal Dataset for Automated Pain Recognition. Scientific Data. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-03878-w
licence: Article CC BY 4.0; dataset subject to academic research data-use agreement
availabilityNote: PMED publishes thermode temperature and wrist Empatica E4 skin temperature. E4 is off the heated site, so like-for-like skin_surface validation is unavailable. Do not compare wrist temperature to simulated contact-site surface temperature.
cohort: 55 healthy adults (PMED); subject-level raw streams not redistributed here
probeLocation: Non-dominant forearm, ~10 cm distal to elbow, CHEPS thermode with Velcro strap
unknowns: Exact strap contact pressure not reported
Contact-site skin temperature under the thermode not published
Subject-specific baseline skin temperature at the heated site not tabulated for redistribution
